# `Q-2-14` — Unclosed Underscore Emphasis

> A `_emphasized_` run opens with `_` but no closing `_` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Underscore-delimited emphasis (`_text_`) must be balanced inside
the same block. This error fires when an opening `_` appears
without a matching close before the block ends.

## Why this happens

Usually a typo, or — less obviously — a literal underscore in
identifier-style text (`some_value`) read as an emphasis opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `_` at the intended end, or escape literal
underscores so the parser treats them as plain characters:

```markdown
The variable `some_value`, or some\_value as a bare token.
```
